youtube.title: Railway patri ke neeche patthar kyun hote hain? 🚆 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Railway patri ke neeche jo patthar bichhe hote hain, wo yun hi nahi pade. Unhe jaanbujhkar nukila toda jaata hai, taaki wo aapas mein phans jayein aur ludhkein nahin.

Har train saikdon tan ka wazan sleepers par daalti hai. Patthar us wazan ko failate hain, sleepers ko tikaye rakhte hain, aur monsoon mein baarish ka paani gaps se seedha nikal jaata hai.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
